name: SHARE (Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting via Shape-Ray Estimation)
definition: A pose-free, feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework that jointly estimates relative camera poses and reconstructs accurate geometry by operating in latent space rather than explicit 3D space, mitigating pose-induced geometry misalignment.
summary: SHARE is a pose-free Gaussian splatting framework that jointly estimates camera poses and 3D geometry in latent space using Plücker rays to guide multi-view feature fusion, avoiding pose-induced misalignment.
